verdict.rationale: Meta's FAQ says Llama models are hosted and distributed by AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, IBM Watsonx, Oracle, Snowflake, Databricks, Groq, Cerebras, SambaNova and others. Community users independently confirm Llama is a first-class LLM option on AWS, Azure, GCP and other major hosts. Missing for 10: no explicit mention of OpenRouter-class routers or gateways, no detailed per-cloud docs (e.g. Bedrock or Vertex specifics), and no evidence on whether the same model versions are available on every cloud.
